segments.text: Here's my honest problem with this book, and it's the most-quoted money book going right now.
It's mostly right. No one's crazy. Be reasonable, not rational. Genuinely wise lines.
But those lines are a trapdoor. They explain every decision after the fact, and warn you of none of them before.
Reasonable felt reasonable, right up until it wasn't. The book hands you permission with no rule attached.
Great book. Just don't mistake comfort for a plan. Full verdict on the channel.
